Hazard Analysis and Risk-Based Preventive Controls

key_insights: Analyzed 689 usable scored letters out of 689 total scored records.
The highest-average-risk issuing office was Office of Manufacturing Quality (avg final risk 0.851, 3 letters).
The highest-average-risk subject token was active pharmaceutical ingredient (api) (avg final risk 0.853, 12 letters).
The highest-average-risk token pair was adulterated + unapproved new animal drug (avg final risk 0.94).
Repeat-letter companies had an average final risk score of 0.237, compared with 0.524 for one-time companies.
The highest-average-risk affected quality system was Document Control (avg final risk 0.899, 6 letters).
